headline: Democrats in the EU Could Revive Regional Minimum Wage Proposal in 2027: Experts
summary: Analysts warn that the return of a Democratic majority to Congress could revive a proposed regional minimum wage for sectors covered by the USMCA. The proposal has not yet been enacted.
why: A regional minimum wage for USMCA sectors would affect labour costs for manufacturers operating across the United States, Mexico and Canada.
original_headline: Demócratas en EU podrían revivir en 2027 propuesta de salario mínimo regional: especialistas
